propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing in verify_models can normalize structurally divergent provider/model responses to empty results treated as valid review outcomes

Raw-empty (no list returned) and malformed-to-empty (all items dropped by reshape) verification chunks are both classified into separate telemetry buckets but already route to indeterminate via pass3_decide's no-verification rule
Semantically empty verification results must never produce valid pass or valid empty review outcomes, regardless of whether the absence came from raw-empty, malformed-to-empty, or unrecoverable paths

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at the kernel-function level, with pipeline-level wiring into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide tracked as follow-up work
Flexible parsing, provider-independent self-healing, and bounded retries must be preserved while rejecting empty outcomes as invalid verification results
